name: JupUSD
oneLiner: JupUSD is Jupiter's dollar stablecoin on Solana, backed 90% by Ethena USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL T-bills) and 10% USDC, with 1:1 mint and redeem against USDC.
collateral: 90% USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL tokenized U.S. Treasuries issued by Ethena under GENIUS-compliant framework, custodied by Porto/Anchorage Digital) and 10% USDC liquidity buffer
pegMechanism: Reserve-backed 1:1 mint and redeem on Solana against USDC; Ethena manages day-to-day reserve operations (custody, bridging, rebalancing between USDtb and USDC)

applicabilityBasis.summary: JupUSD is a USD-pegged reserve-backed token issued on Solana for payment/settlement use within Jupiter's DeFi ecosystem; it presents as a payment stablecoin under GENIUS Act definitions. Jupiter's Terms of Service restrict US-based users, but this is an access restriction, not a legal carve-out from GENIUS applicability.

genius.issuerEntity: Jupiter (Solana DEX aggregator, no disclosed US legal entity; Ethena Labs operates issuance backend)
genius.notes: JupUSD's primary reserve asset (USDtb) is now issued in the US by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. under a GENIUS-compliant framework (announced July 24, 2025; Anchorage is the USDtb issuer, not JupUSD's issuer). JupUSD itself has no GENIUS authorization — it is a separate token issued by Jupiter on Solana with no disclosed US legal entity or regulatory registration. Jupiter restricts US users in its ToS but no formal foreign-exception determination has been made. No public GENIUS approval, application, or issuer pathway source for JupUSD itself was located.

references.label: Anchorage Digital — Ethena USDtb GENIUS-compliant issuance announcement (July 24 2025)

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule (Bulletin 2026-3) and public releases — no JupUSD or Jupiter issuer listing

Anchorage Digital / Ethena Labs USDtb GENIUS-compliant launch (July 24 2025) — confirms USDtb is GENIUS-compliant via Anchorage Digital Bank N.A.; JupUSD is a separate token not covered by this authorization
JupUSD issuer disclosures and developer documentation — no regulatory authorization disclosed
Web search across US permitted-issuer, state-qualified, official-application, and foreign-exception materials — no Jupiter or JupUSD-specific result found
Jupiter Terms of Service (US user access restriction noted) — no formal foreign-exception determination found
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No GENIUS approval, application, or issuer pathway for JupUSD or its issuer (Jupiter) found across federal/state regulator sources and issuer disclosures. USDtb's Anchorage/GENIUS pathway applies to the reserve asset issuer (Anchorage Digital Bank N.A.), not JupUSD itself.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: JupUSD mint authority is a PDA of the immutable JupUSD program (JUPUSDecMzAVgztLe6eGhwUBj1Pn3j9WAXwmtHmfbRr, upgradeAuthority: None). Minting and redemption are gated by program logic to KYC/KYB-verified institutional participants. The program upgrade path is locked; minting cannot be altered without redeploying a new mint.

controls.label: JupUSD mint and freeze authority (PDA of immutable JupUSD program)
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425778546, JupUSD mint JuprjznTrTSp2UFa3ZBUFgwdAmtZCq4MQCwysN55USD (standard SPL-Token) returned mintAuthority and freezeAuthority both as CkzLnD9r4d4ZZofsgNVo2VNunxDmte5YJ4vfAgMfBZNA. getAccountInfo for that address returned null (unfunded PDA). Redemption transaction (slot 425618663, sig uNQV...UHN) shows program JUPUSDecMzAVgztLe6eGhwUBj1Pn3j9WAXwmtHmfbRr invoking Redeem and calling TokenkegQ MintTo, confirming this is a PDA of JUPUSDecMzA. JUPUSDecMzA programData GF7fy... has upgradeAuthority: None (immutable at slot 425780430).

controls.label: Ethena Labs issuance backend / reserve operator
controls.evidence: JupUSD is issued on Ethena Labs' Stablecoin-as-a-Service infrastructure; Ethena manages reserve operations, custody coordination (Porto/Anchorage), and rebalancing between USDtb and USDC, operating the mint/redeem framework on Jupiter's behalf. This issuer-backend role is consistent with the immutable program gating on-chain.

review.evidence: At Solana slot 425780430: JupUSD mint authority confirmed as PDA of immutable program JUPUSDecMzAVgztLe6eGhwUBj1Pn3j9WAXwmtHmfbRr (upgradeAuthority: None). Mint authority CkzL... is null/unfunded PDA that signs via program CPI. Live redemption tx confirms the program handles mint/burn. The upgrade path is locked; permissioned-minter logic is enforced by immutable on-chain code.
